The 200 malformed kernel candidates remain a separate nonacceptance/panic lane, not well-typed Wasm or backend-control coverage.
assumptions: The compiler, kernel, Wasm engine, host observation decoder and harness remain trusted; shared bugs may invalidate the independent arithmetic, recipe and effect oracles.
The retained environment binds the exact compiler binary, runtime source snapshot, tool selection, ABI, resource-free host mappings and limits; it is not a universal compilation provenance proof.
Only independently accepted, executed, in-domain agreeing trials count as passed; generator failure, counterexample, invalid shrink and exhausted budgets remain separately classified controls.

exports.begin: (allocation_bytes:i32,recipe_leaves:i32,program_depth:i32,operand_bytes:i32,continuation_bytes:i32,steps:i32)->status:i32; preserves persistent values/stack, resets per-submission metrics, cannot clear a prior failure
exports.submit: ()->status:i32; checks exact current ordered input stack, initializes inert literals/recipes, executes this module once through bounded compiled continuations, checks exact output stack, advances generation on success
exports.push_i64: (value:i64)->status:i32; host-only typed scalar injection after compilation and before submit
exports.push_program: (handle:i32)->status:i32; only accepts existing live Program cells, never constructs code
exports.stack_value: (index:i32)->i64; scalar value or unsigned cell handle
exports.observe: (stack_index:i32)->status:i32; serializes a Program or Syntax exact recipe into bounded prefix events without executing code
exports.signature_address: (id:i32)->UTF-8 descriptor address:i32; use the latest module to inspect all committed signature IDs

cells.layout: 48 immutable bytes: kind:i32,id:i32,payload:i64,a:i32,b:i32,c:i32,x:i32,y:i32,z:i32,w:i32,n:i32. Handles 1..4096 address 65536+(handle-1)*48. a/b/c are nullable backward cell edges; inspect only live handles obtained from checked output.
cells.Program: payload=latent effect bitmask (bit0 emit, bit1 abort), a/b=immutable captures/compose children, c=exact recipe, x=compiled table entry, y/z=complete ordered input/output signature IDs, w=program depth,n=recipe leaves. Signature IDs are stable across Compiler commits. No exported constructor accepts these fields.
cells.Recipe.Atom: x=atom tag,payload=scalar or immutable semantic definition identity,a=nested Program/data cell; tag8 y=complete one-slot captured data signature ID; tags2/15 y=invocation input signature,z=invocation output signature,w=invocation latent effect mask

recipe_events.15: immutable user definition identity (unsigned i64 bits)
recipe_events.16: captured data complete one-slot type signature ID
recipe_events.17: Program complete ordered input signature ID
recipe_events.18: Program complete ordered output signature ID

abi.signature_grammar: Bottom-first [T T ...]; T=I64|Bool|Unit|Text|Syntax|List(T)|Pair(T,T)|Sum(T,T)|Program([T ...]->[T ...]!{effect IDs}). Empty effects omit !{}. Program effect IDs are sorted decimal 0=emit,1=abort. No resource types are admitted by this backend.
abi.compiler_limits: One shared Request.limits.work budget covers structural preflight, payload/dependency validation, conservative full-environment cost, separate reserved kernel dependency/node-check allowances for every specialization/root, identity comparison and lowering/type/signature work. Additional hard bounds: 4096 candidate nodes total, 256 specialization entries, 512 nodes and 64 edges per structural type/pattern path, 128 stack slots, 8 instantiation bindings, 4096 session signatures, 1 MiB emitted WAT. Exhaustion returns no module and changes no Compiler state.
abi.lifecycle: Create one memory/table/global set per Compiler. Import it unchanged into each successive module; retain instances. Instantiation has no start function and changes no shared memory/table/globals: code and literal segments are passive. submit first checks generation and exact inputs, then installs its disjoint code/data before constructing inert recipes and executing. Call begin then inject explicitly typed inputs if needed then submit once. Compiler commit and frontend definition commit happen only after successful module preparation/instantiation. A nonzero runtime status or native engine/host trap poisons/ends the session; no rollback of already-issued host trace is claimed. Static preparation/assembly/instantiation refusals leave prior namespace and operand stack unchanged. The shell must never modify memory/table/global internals or forge heap handles. Reflection events are inert and are never executable input.

abi.signature_grammar: Bottom-first [T T ...]; T=I64|Bool|Unit|Text|Syntax|List(T)|Pair(T,T)|Sum(T,T)|Program([T ...]->[T ...]!{effect IDs}). Empty effects omit !{}. Program effect IDs are sorted decimal 0=emit,1=abort. No resource types are admitted by this backend.
abi.compiler_limits: One shared Request.limits.work budget covers structural preflight, payload/dependency validation, conservative full-environment cost, separate reserved kernel dependency/node-check allowances for every specialization/root, identity comparison and lowering/type/signature work. Additional hard bounds: 4096 candidate nodes total, 256 specialization entries, 512 nodes and 64 edges per structural type/pattern path, 128 stack slots, 8 instantiation bindings, 4096 session signatures, 1 MiB emitted WAT. Exhaustion returns no module and changes no Compiler state.
abi.lifecycle: Create one memory/table/global set per Compiler. Import it unchanged into each successive module; retain instances. Instantiation has no start function and changes no shared memory/table/globals: code and literal segments are passive. submit first checks generation and exact inputs, then installs its disjoint code/data before constructing inert recipes and executing. Call begin then inject explicitly typed inputs if needed then submit once. Compiler commit and frontend definition commit happen only after successful module preparation/instantiation. A nonzero runtime status or native engine/host trap poisons/ends the session; no rollback of already-issued host trace is claimed. Static preparation/assembly/instantiation refusals leave prior namespace and operand stack unchanged. The shell must never modify memory/table/global internals or forge heap handles. Reflection events are inert and are never executable input.
